documents.abstract: An efficient synthesis of 5'-homoaristeromycin has been developed. This permitted an extensive antiviral analysis, which found potent activity toward vaccinia, cowpox, and monkeypox viruses. For comparative purposes, 5'-homoadenosine was made available by a newly designed route and found to be inactive.
documents.title: 5'-Homoaristeromycin. Synthesis and antiviral activity against orthopox viruses.
